purpose: Benchmark definitions both LLM servers use, so results from the AMD and NVIDIA servers are measured the same way. Hardware-specific parts (engines, launch settings, guards, load caps) stay in each server's own repository.

quality_ranking.name: short tool-use test
quality_ranking.items_note: NVIDIA's frozen list (version fast-1, built November 22, 2026); committed here on November 26 so both servers use the same 55 items.
quality_ranking.order: the 40 single-turn items first, then multi-turn episodes in triplets (base, missing parameter, missing function), in the manifest's order

large.for: models that stream from SSD or keep experts in RAM; adds the 6 "ext" episodes

quality_ranking.score: 50 * (single-turn correct / 40) + 50 * (core episodes passed / 9), out of 100; both groups are ranked on these 49 items; large runs also report a 15-episode figure
quality_ranking.cut_items: left out, not wrong; coverage is reported
per_server: load cap (load time is not scored)
which route goes in which group

steps: one strict DSH read-tool round trip through the server's router or hub, then an owned unload
gBench Golden Set, the six chat-template and tool-call cases below

speed_report.measurement: the DSH read-tool round trip above, from a cold start, one request at a time, single run unless stated
speed_report.label: say whether the prompt cache was reused and that one run is one run

amd: rank tier (hardware/quant-eval/rank), not yet on NVIDIA
quick quality test blocks beyond block G
